column3: Switch to PRG bank X on the NMI-safe path, then return.\nIn: X = bank. Updates CUR_BANK and the MMC1 PRG register.
Wait for two vblanks, then store PPU CTRL 10h and mask 0 in the shadows and the registers.\nNMI is left disabled. Called from RESET.
Call bank 5 at AC8A and AC54, then zero 00h-FBh and pages 0200h-0700h.\nFC-FF on the zero page are left alone.
Reset MMC1, clear the saved bank and CUR_BANK, and map bank 0 at 8000h.
Write the MMC1 reset sequence: control 0Eh (16K PRG at 8000h, fixed C000h), CHR banks 0.\nDoes not select the PRG bank.
Clear scroll, split mode and the NMI counter. PPU CTRL shadow 10h, mask shadow 1Eh.\nClear OAM, mark it ready, clear the palette-dirty flag, and jump to START_AUDIO.
Zero SPLIT_SCROLL_X, SPLIT_CTRL_BIT, SCROLL_X, SCROLL_NT and SCROLL_Y.
Wait until PPUSTATUS leaves vblank, then until it enters vblank again.
Clear NMI_CNT and return after the next NMI increments it.
Return after FRAME_CNT changes. Spins, so it must be called with NMI enabled.
Write SCROLL_X, SCROLL_Y and PPU CTRL (shadow ORed with bit 0 of SCROLL_NT) to the PPU.
Wait until the PPU queue is empty, then in vblank DMA sprites, upload PAL_BUF,\napply scroll, set the mask to 1Eh and enable NMI. Sets PPU_ENABLED.
Set bit 7 of the PPU CTRL shadow and write it to the register.
Wait for an empty PPU queue, clear the split and the OAM buffer, then blank the mask.\nClears PPU_ENABLED and calls AUDIO_CMD_80. Waits one frame on either side.
Clear bit 7 of the PPU CTRL shadow and write it to the register.
Enable the sprite-0 split with sprite 0 at Y=10h (SPLIT_MODE=1).\nTurns NMI off, waits a frame, turns NMI on. Out: A=0.
Enable the sprite-0 split with sprite 0 at Y=90h (SPLIT_MODE=80h).\nSame NMI off/on bracket as SET_TOP_SPLIT.
DMA the page-7 OAM buffer to the PPU. Clobbers A.
Hide every sprite (Y=F8h) and clear OAM_READY. If SPLIT_MODE is set, sprite 0 is\nrewritten from SPRITE0_Y with tile 3F and attribute 20h. OAM_INDEX becomes 0 or 4.
Set OAM_READY so the next NMI will DMA the sprite buffer and then clear it.
Point the PPU address at 3F00h and then at 0000h so a later render does not show a palette glitch.

Read the controllers once per NMI.
US: probe for signature 10h/20h. On a match use READ_JOY_ALT and set JOY_SIG_OK, else READ_JOY_STD.
A second sample that differs is discarded and the previous frame is kept.
Fills JOYPAD1-3, the _NEW and _OLD bytes, JOY_HELD and JOY_NEW.

Strobe the pads and shift in 8 bits twice.
First pass: port1 bit0 -> JOYPAD1, port1 bit1 -> JOYPAD3, port2 bit0 -> JOYPAD2.
Second pass: the same bits into JOYPAD1_2ND, JOYPAD3_2ND, JOYPAD2_2ND.
On US this is the fallback when the probe misses. On JP it is the whole read, and it also builds the _NEW and OR bytes.

US only. Read pads with the AND-3 CMP-1 test, then shift 8 more bits into JOY_PROBE_1 and JOY_PROBE_2.\nReturns Z set when the probe bytes are 10h and 20h. The mode menu rejects Z_49=2 while JOY_SIG_OK stays 0.
US only. Second pad read, used when READ_JOY_PROBE matches.\nSame AND-3 test into the _2ND bytes, then 8 bits of port1 bit0 into JOYPAD3_2ND.
Fill nametable 2000h with A (8 pages), then zero the 128 bytes at 0420h (ATTR_BUF).\nIn: A = tile. Clobbers X and Y.
Write 40h zeros to attribute tables 23C0h and 27C0h.
Write A to PPUDATA, X times. In: A = byte, X = count (1-256, 0 means 256).
Copy X groups of 4 bytes from (16h) into PAL_BUF at index A*4.\nIn: A = palette row, X = row count, 16h/17h = source.
Set PAL_DIRTY so the next NMI uploads PAL_BUF.

Play sound command 85h, then darken PAL_BUF one step at a time.\nEach non-0F byte loses 10h from its high nibble, otherwise it becomes 0Fh.\nMarks the palette dirty and waits 5 NMIs per step until every byte is 0Fh.
Fill all 32 palette bytes with 0Fh and upload them to 3F00h immediately.
If PAL_DIRTY is set, write PAL_BUF to PPU 3F00h and clear the flag.\nOut: C=1 if an upload ran (NMI then skips the PPU queue), C=0 if it did not.
Set the PPU address to X*100h+A. In: X = high, A = low.

Switch to bank X and decode Y tiles of 16 bytes to the PPU address in 22h/23h.\nSource is (20h). Each tile is two calls to DECODE_CHR. Restores the previous bank.\nIn: X = bank, Y = tile count, 20h = source, 22h = PPU address.
Switch to bank X and copy Y*16 raw bytes from (20h) to PPU address 22h/23h.\nRestores the previous bank. Used by the bank-5 tile upload at 802Fh.

Decode 8 pixels of one CHR bitplane from (20h) into 1Eh.\nA 0 bit repeats the previous byte; a 1 bit reads a new byte. Bits live in 1Dh.\nThe upload that starts at bank 1 B724h reads past that bank into C000h-C122h of this fixed bank. That is original behavior (see shift_ignore).

Drain up to 8 records from PPU_QUEUE.\nA record whose first byte is nonzero is [flags][hi][lo][count][bytes]. Bit 7 of flags sets the PPU increment-32 mode.\nA record whose first byte is 0 is a 2x2 tile plus one attribute byte (9 bytes total).

Queue one 2x2 tile and its attribute nibble. Spins until 10 queue bytes are free.\nUses 04A9h-04B4h as the address, tiles and masks. Updates ATTR_BUF.\nIn: those work bytes already filled by QUEUE_MAP_TILE.
Four attribute masks, one per 2x2 quadrant inside an attribute byte: FC F3 CF 3F.
Palette index 0-3 expanded to a full attribute byte: 00 55 AA FF.\nQUEUE_TILE indexes this with the map nibble, which is therefore 0-3.
Tile column X and row Y to a nametable address in 22h/23h.\nX below 20h uses nametable 2000h; otherwise the column wraps and the base is 2400h.\nIn: X, Y. Out: 22h = address. Clobbers A.

Tile column X and row Y to an attribute address.\nOut: 23h = high (23h or 27h), 22h = low ORed with C0h, 1Ch = offset inside the attribute byte group.\nWraps X at 20h and Y at 1Eh onto the second screen.

Queue a raw PPU run. Spins until 25h bytes are free, then writes\n[2Eh ORed with 01h][23h][22h][count][count bytes from (20h)].\nIn: X = count, 22h/23h = PPU address, 20h = source, 2Eh = flag byte (bit 7 selects vertical increment).
Test whether the PPU queue can take A more bytes.\nOut: C=1 if the gap from PPU_Q_WR to PPU_Q_RD is large enough. A gap of 0 is treated as empty, so C=1.
Spin until PPU_Q_WR equals PPU_Q_RD. NMI must be enabled.
Step the 3-byte RNG in RNG_1..RNG_3.\nOut: A = RNG_3. The bytes after the RTS are never executed.
Clear SND_NMI_LOCK, map bank 2, and jump to L2_8000. Does not return.
Load A with 80h and fall into AUDIO_CALL. Used when the PPU is turned off.
Call the bank-2 sound routine at D803h (which jumps to L2_806Dh).\nIn: A = command, X = argument. Out: A and X from that routine. Restores the previous bank.
AUDIO_CALL with A=85h and X=80h. Called once at the start of FADE_PALETTE.
Reset entry after the cold init. Clears the demo flag, runs the opening, then the menu.\nFrom here the loop boots a stage, plays STAGE_LOOP, and branches on clear, death, demo or bonus.
Front end. SHOW_FRONT, then if the demo flag is set jump into STAGE_BOOT.\nOtherwise RUN_MODE_MENU. W_054E repeats this loop. W_054F goes to ENTER_Z49_1.\nW_0550 goes to ENTER_W0550.
Re-enter a mode without the title. Clears 8 bytes at 03D0h, calls SET_WIN_COUNT, then STAGE_BOOT.\nReached when Z_4A is set after a versus result or the game-over screen.
Blank the screen and set lives (04E5h) to 2. If Z_4A is set, keep the current area and stage.\nIf W_04C9 is negative, all areas are done. Otherwise it becomes the area and the stage is 0.
Copy W_04C9 into the area, zero the stage, call bank 5 at 9936h (zeros 055Eh-0560h) and RESET_PLAYERS.
Build one stage: area card, mode setup, clear nametables, CHR, palettes, enemies.\nEnables the PPU, the top split and the area BGM, then falls into STAGE_LOOP.

One in-stage frame: wait for NMI, pause, players, blasts, enemies, then several bank-5 calls.\nZ_B7 at or above F0h leaves the stage. Z_53 counts up to F0h and then takes the death path.\nOtherwise MARK_OAM and repeat.
Stage exit after a fade. Demo returns through DEMO_EXIT. Nonzero Z_B4 goes to PREP_STAGE_B4.\nOtherwise advance the stage, and the area after stage 8. Area 6 goes to ALL_CLEAR.
Area index reached 6. Call RUN_ENDING and then RESET.
Fade out after Z_53 hit F0h. In a versus mode, score the round and maybe show the result.\nIn story mode, decrement lives. Negative lives run the game-over screen. Otherwise reload the stage.
Return from a demo stage. If the demo flag is negative, go back to the menu path at C954h.\nIf the demo index is 3, restart at GAME_LOOP. Otherwise repeat MENU_LOOP.
If Z_49 is 0, play AREA_BGM_ID indexed by the area. Otherwise play sound 14h.
Six sound ids, one per area 0-5: 0E 0F 0E 0F 0E 10. Read by PLAY_AREA_BGM.
Z_B4 was nonzero after a clear. FARCALL bank 5 at 9E92h, which saves the area and stage,\nforces stage 7, Z_90=8, Z_93=5 and Z_4E=1, then returns to STAGE_WON.
Load area CHR and the sprite palettes, then return from the tail at CB14h.\nCB14h also copies 16 bytes of area palette data from bank 4 and mirrors the background color.
Copy PAL_BUF byte 0 onto the background color of the other seven 4-byte rows.
16 sprite-palette bytes (4 rows) copied to PAL_BUF row 4 when Z_49 is 0.
16 sprite-palette bytes copied to PAL_BUF row 4 when Z_49 is not 0.

Upload fixed CHR from bank 6 at 8000h (80h tiles to PPU 1000h),
area CHR from AREA_CHR_PTR (60h tiles to 1A00h), and enemy CHR from bank 1.
Area 5 picks the enemy set with AREA5_CHR_IDX[stage]; other areas use the area index.
Enemy tiles go to PPU 0C00h, 40h tiles. Does not restore the bank itself; the caller does.
Eight indexes, one per stage, selecting an ENEMY_CHR_PTR entry when the area is 5.
Six pointers to area CHR in bank 6. First pointer is split lo/hi; the rest are words.\nLOAD_AREA_CHR uploads 60h tiles from the selected pointer.
Seven pointers to enemy CHR in bank 1. Indexed by area, or by AREA5_CHR_IDX in area 5.\n40h tiles are uploaded to PPU 0C00h. Entry 5 is the same address as entry 4.

If Start is newly pressed and no death or clear is running, slide SPLIT_SCROLL_X by 8 until FCh\nand draw PAUSE_TEXT. Start again restores the scroll and returns.\nWhile the demo flag is set, Start or A sets that flag to FFh and Z_53 to F0h so the demo exits.
Five ASCII bytes "PAUSE", queued by UPDATE_PAUSE. The US pointer is CCB2h; the JP build uses the same bytes at its own address.
W_054F was nonzero. FARCALL bank 5 at 9FC0h, which sets Z_49 to 1 and runs its own frame loop.\nThat call does not return; the following jump back to GAME_LOOP is not reached.
W_0550 was nonzero. Set lives to 1, clear 8 bytes at 03D0h, FARCALL bank 5 at 9E92h,\nfade out, blank the PPU and jump to GAME_LOOP.

Draw a metasprite into the OAM buffer at OAM_INDEX.\n54h/55h = data. First byte is the number of 4-byte groups (tile, dx, dy, attr), then FF-terminated runs.\n56h/57h = X, 58h/59h = Y, 5Ah = flip bits. X is reduced by SCROLL_X and Y by SCROLL_Y before the draw.
FARCALL bank 4 at B800h. That routine sets 62h/64h/66h from tables indexed by the area.
FARCALL bank 4 at B909h. That routine loads a per-stage byte into Z_2A and 04E2h (32h if Z_49 is not 0) and then scatters objects with NEXT_RNG.
FARCALL bank 5 at 802Fh, which uploads 4 raw tiles to PPU 1800h from a bank-6 table selected by 04E3h.
Zero A9h and AAh, clear the round flags, then fall into INIT_PLAYERS.

Set up three actor slots. Each Z_69 entry is 1. X and Y come from PLAYER_SPAWN_X/Y.\nClears the per-slot bytes at 75h, 7Eh, 81h, 84h, 87h, 96h, 99h and 7Bh.\nIf Z_53 is nonzero, also clears several work bytes and copies 10 bytes from 0404h into 04D0h.
Three starting X positions, one per actor slot: 18h, D8h, 78h. Read by INIT_PLAYERS.
Three starting Y positions, one per actor slot: 18h, B8h, 78h. Read by INIT_PLAYERS.
Zero AE AE-adjacent round bytes AD, B0, B3, B4, B5, AF (AF is replaced by 03EEh when Z_49 is 0).\nThen copy MODE_BYTE_90/93, indexed by Z_49, into Z_90 and Z_93.
Three bytes indexed by Z_49 and stored in Z_90: 00, 01, 00. Also used by the demo setup path.
Three bytes indexed by Z_49 and stored in Z_93: 00, 02, 01.
FARCALL bank 5 at 8168h. That routine advances Z_B7 when it is nonzero, otherwise walks the Z_69 slots.

If Z_B5 is positive, Z_B0 is 1, and the WRAM cell at 611Eh/615Ah matches 9Dh/9Eh,\nset Z_B6 from 61D2h and Z_B5 from BLAST_TYPE_TAB indexed by the low nibble of 60E2h.\nIn: Y = index into those WRAM arrays.
16 bytes. NOTE_BLAST_TYPE stores entry [low nibble of X_60E2] into Z_B5.\nEntries 9-15 are 00. ? what the 80h-83h values select.
If Z_4E is set, increment Z_B7 and play sound 16h.\nOtherwise mark every live slot (Z_69 set, Z_84 clear) with Z_81=8, Z_7E=0, Z_84=1 and play sound 04h if any slot changed.
Add 2 to Y and fall into QUEUE_MAP_TILE. In: A = tile id, X = column, Y = row before the add.

Queue the 2x2 tile A at column X, row Y.\nFour tile bytes come from (62h) at A*4. The attribute nibble comes from (66h), one nibble per tile id.\nSwitches to bank 4 for the read, then calls QUEUE_TILE and restores the bank.
Zero 0518h and the 15 bytes at 04EBh.
Map bank 5 and call BA56h, which walks the 24 slots at X_6001 on alternate frames. Restores the bank.
Zero 24 bytes at 6001h, 60 bytes at 60E2h, 32 bytes at 60C1h, and 60E1h, 6000h, 624Dh-624Fh.
Zero X_60C1 at index X_60E1, then advance that index modulo 32.
Search 24 slots at X_6001 for a flag that is positive and whose X_6019/X_6031 cell equals Z_28/Z_29.\nOut: C=1 and Y=slot if found, C=0 if not.
Search 60 slots at X_60E2 (index 3Bh down). Skip a flag of 0.\nOut: Y = slot whose X_611E/X_615A cell equals Z_28/Z_29, or FFh if none.
Find a zero flag in the 15 bytes at 04EBh.\nOut: C=1 and X=slot if one is free, C=0 if all 15 are in use.
Search the 15 slots at 04EBh for a nonzero flag whose 04FAh/0509h cell equals Z_28/Z_29.\nOut: C=1 and X=slot if found, C=0 if not.
FARCALL bank 5 at A18Eh. That routine blanks the PPU, sets SCROLL_Y to 60h and SCROLL_NT to 1, and fills the nametable with tile 0 before drawing the rest of the screen.
FARCALL bank 5 at AA6Ah. Called when lives go negative. That routine draws a screen, sets Z_4A to 1, plays sound 19h and waits on its own NMI loop.
FARCALL bank 5 at A80Fh. That routine clears W_054E, W_054F and W_0550, fills the nametable with tile 13h, and zeros Z_49 and W_04C9 before its own input loop.
FARCALL bank 5 at AB65h. The caller points 20h at a record: column, row, count, then bytes written straight to the PPU.
Zero the 10 bytes at X_6250 and set X_62DC and X_62DD to 1.
If Z_49 is 0, map bank 0 and call 824Fh and 82FEh for each of the 10 X_6250 slots that is nonzero, then 83BEh, 8179h, 81A6h and 821Eh.\nAlways increments X_62DD. Restores the bank.
FARCALL bank 0 at 8000h. That routine walks a list and places entries when Z_4E and Z_49 are both 0.
FARCALL bank 0 at 8090h. That routine uses FRAME_CNT and steps an index in X_62E6.
FARCALL bank 5 at 9254h, which fills 1A0h bytes at 62F3h with FFh.

Copy one layout byte into the live map. Returns if Y is 13 or more.\nIn: Y = map row, X = column, A = index along (64h). Switches to bank 4 for the read. Out: the byte is stored through the row pointer.
Point 2Fh/30h at map row Y. Rows are 20h bytes apart starting at 62F3h. 13 rows.\nIn: Y = row 0-12. Out: 2Fh = address from MAP_ROW_LO/HI.
13 low bytes of the live map row addresses. High bytes are MAP_ROW_HI.\nRows are 62F3h, 6313h, ... 6473h (stride 20h). Not PRG pointers.
Read one live map byte. In: X = column, Y = row. Out: A = byte at that cell. Uses MAP_ROW_PTR.
FARCALL bank 5 at ACE4h. That routine returns immediately unless the demo flag is clear, Z_49 and the stage are 0, and the area differs from Z_4D. It then shows a screen and plays sound 11h.
FARCALL bank 5 at B07Dh. Called when the area reaches 6. That routine blanks the PPU, forces area 6 stage 0 and calls LOAD_MODE_GFX.
FARCALL bank 5 at B186h. Called once from GAME_LOOP. Zeros Z_49, Z_4E and Z_B4, then sets area 6 stage 1 and calls into bank 0.
FARCALL bank 5 at 9280h. Fills 9 bytes at 03DBh with FFh, sets 03EDh to 4Bh and 03EEh to 0.
FARCALL bank 5 at 9562h. Stores a nonzero RNG nibble, the area, the stage and Z_90 into W_03E4 and the following bytes.
FARCALL bank 5 at B209h. Called from the versus round-end path. Sets Z_4A to 1 and plays sound 1Ch around a screen of its own.
FARCALL bank 5 at B4F9h. If Z_49 is not 2, store 5 in W_0563. If Z_49 is 2, that routine draws a screen instead.
Dispatch the pre-stage screen by Z_49.\n0 calls bank 5 at B8F6h, 2 calls B5DAh, anything else calls B6F5h.\nEach of those turns NMI off, calls LOAD_MODE_GFX, draws, and plays sound 1Dh.

Upload the mode CHR and palettes. Uses bank 1 for one CHR block and bank 4 for palettes selected by MODE_PAL_PTR[Z_49].\nThen copies 16 more palette bytes from bank 4 at B129h and mirrors the background color.
Three pointers, indexed by Z_49, to 16-byte palette rows in bank 4.\nEntry 0 is B139h. Entries 1 and 2 are both B119h. LOAD_MODE_GFX copies the selected row to PAL_BUF.
Zero W_03F0, the demo record index.
Zero W_03EF. STAGE_LOOP and STAGE_WON treat a nonzero value as a demo, and a negative value as "leave the demo".

Load demo record W_03F0 (0-3) and set the demo flag.\nEach record is 8 bytes: area, stage, Z_90, Z_93, RNG_1, RNG_2, RNG_3, and one unused byte.\nAlso sets Z_4A, Z_AF and W_03EF to 1, clears Z_53 and FRAME_CNT, and advances the stored index modulo 4.

Four demo records of 8 bytes, indexed by W_03F0*8.\nBytes at this label and the next six labels are area, stage, Z_90, Z_93, RNG_1, RNG_2, RNG_3.\nThe eighth byte of each record is not read by START_DEMO.
One byte, value 01h. Bank 5 at 99EDh skips copying JOYPAD1 into the demo slots when this byte is nonzero.
Power-on entry. Disable IRQ, clear decimal, set the stack, then warm up the PPU,\nblack the palette, reset MMC1, clear RAM, reset video and enter GAME_LOOP.

Increment NMI_CNT. If OAM_READY, DMA sprites. Upload the palette or else drain the PPU queue.
When SPLIT_MODE is set, wait for sprite 0 and apply the split scroll; 80h also sets the PPU address to 2660h.
Then the normal scroll. If OAM_READY, clear the sprite buffer. On the first NMI after a clear of NMI_CNT, read the pads.
Once per frame, if SND_NMI_LOCK is 0, tick the bank-2 sound routine. Increments FRAME_CNT.
